question.text: Under Section 15HAA, what acts regarding electronic databases of SEBI attract penalties?

answer.text: Only introducing a computer virus or contaminant into the system database causing a trading halt

Unauthorized access or modification of access parameters, unauthorized downloading or copying of regulatory data, introducing a virus or contaminant causing a trading halt, disrupting database functioning, and damaging or destroying regulatory data
Only unauthorized access or modification of access parameters to the regulatory database
Only unauthorized downloading, extraction, or copying of regulatory data from the system database

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 15HAA attracts penalties for every one of the listed acts: unauthorized access or modification of access parameters to a regulatory database, unauthorized downloading or copying of regulatory data, introducing a computer virus or contaminant that causes a trading halt, unauthorized disruption of database functioning, and knowingly damaging or destroying regulatory data. The Trap: Each "Only..." option lists a single Section 15HAA offence in isolation. Because Section 15HAA penalises all of them, picking a single act misses the comprehensive scope. Note: Section 15HAA targets a broad spectrum of cyber-related misconduct against SEBI's regulatory databases, ranging from passive unauthorized access through to active destruction of data.
